verdict.rationale: Latham's Emerging Companies & Growth page says the firm provides "tailored, cost-conscious company formation services" at the earliest stages. LathamDrive also offers a document generator for creating incorporation documents and organizes its resources around a Formation stage, so engaging the firm for incorporation is documented as part of the practice. The evidence never names the specific deliverables, so coverage is only partial. Missing for 10: explicit mention of charter/certificate of incorporation drafting, bylaws, initial board consents, founder stock purchase agreements, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the formation engagement.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice

citations.quote: We provide tailored, cost-conscious company formation services and strategic counsel at the earliest stages
Legal document generator allows entrepreneurs to create the documents necessary to incorporate a company.
